Clean, modern technical flowchart for a professional software handover document. Flat vector style, pure white background (#FFFFFF), generous whitespace, no gradients, no 3D, no drop shadows heavier than a soft 4px blur, no clip-art, no emoji. Font: Plus Jakarta Sans (or a similar geometric sans), labels in dark ink #1B1F2A, bold for node titles, regular for small sub-labels. Nodes are rounded rectangles (16px radius) with a light tinted fill and a 2px border in the same hue, darker shade. Arrows are 2px solid #475166 lines with small filled arrowheads, orthogonal (right-angle) routing, never crossing. Decisions are rounded diamonds. Async/background work uses dashed borders and dashed arrows. Data stores are cylinders. Landscape 16:9, 2400×1350 px, all text horizontal and legible at 50% zoom. Spelling must be exact. Title at top-left: "Reef Vision Studio — system architecture". Three stacked horizontal layers, left to right flow:
Layer 1 (orange #F76707): "Tauri v2 desktop shell (Rust)" with sub-labels "spawns backend from .venv", "health-checks 127.0.0.1:8000", "native save dialog".
Layer 2 (violet #7048E8): "React 19 + Vite UI" with three child nodes "Upload view", "Image analysis view", "Video analysis view"; small note "services/api.ts — every backend call".
Layer 3 (green #0CA678): "FastAPI engine (local, port 8000)" with routers "system", "images", "batch", "video".
Under the engine, an orange (#E8590C) box "ONNX Runtime" containing three model chips: "CoralSCOP (SAM encoder + decoder)", "BioCLIP visual encoder", "YOLO11n bleaching detector".
On the right, a grey cloud node "Hugging Face Hub — harsh-awasthi/Andromeida-ReefVision-ONNX" with a dashed arrow labelled "first launch: download" into ONNX Runtime.
At the bottom a cylinder "SQLite (video jobs, WAL)" and a folder icon "Exports: COCO, CSV, MP4".
Arrows: UI ⇄ FastAPI labelled "HTTP / JSON"; Tauri → FastAPI labelled "starts + monitors".
Output: one standalone image, 2400×1350 pixels, preserve that aspect ratio. No watermarks. Do not draw a company logo or company wordmark; repository identifier strings explicitly quoted in diagrams must remain exact.
